CVE-2026-96881.summary_ko: TaleLin lin-cms-spring-boot의 book 엔드포인트 내 getBooks 함수에서 부적절한 권한 부여 취약점이 확인되었습니다.

CVE-2026-96882.description: A vulnerability was identified in TaleLin lin-cms-spring-boot up to 0.2.1. Affected by this vulnerability is the function searchBook of the file src/main/java/io/github/talelin/latticy/controller/v1/BookController.java of the component book Endpoint. The manipulation leads to improper authorization. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
CVE-2026-96882.summary_ko: TaleLin lin-cms-spring-boot의 book 엔드포인트 내 searchBook 함수에서 부적절한 권한 부여 취약점이 발생합니다.

CVE-2026-96884.description: A security flaw has been discovered in MantisZip up to 0.4.5. Affected by this issue is the function Path.Combine of the file MainWindow.UI.cs of the component Preview. The manipulation results in path traversal. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-96891.description: A vulnerability was identified in D-Link DIR-825 3.00b32. Affected is the function tunnel_set_params of the file tunnel.c of the component rp-l2tp. The manipulation of the argument peer_hostname leads to out-of-bounds write. The attack may be initiated remotely.
CVE-2026-96891.summary_ko: D-Link DIR-825의 rp-l2tp 컴포넌트 내 tunnel.c 파일에서 peer_hostname 인자 조작으로 인해 원격에서 트리거될 수 있는 경계 초과 쓰기 취약점이 발견되었습니다.

CVE-2026-97149.description: In OpenStack Swift before 2.38.2, the tempurl middleware does not reject the X-Copy-From header on PUT requests. A TempURL signature only covers the method, expiry, and path, and thus the list of disallowed headers is the only defense against a signed PUT request changing what the request does. An attacker holding a PUT TempURL for a single object can add an X-Copy-From header naming any object in the same account; the copy middleware copies that object to the destination, and the attacker then reads the victim's data back with a GET TempURL for the destination object. Copies across account boundaries are rejected. Only deployments using the shipped default proxy pipeline (tempurl and copy middleware) with account-level TempURL keys are affected.
CVE-2026-97149.summary_ko: OpenStack Swift 2.38.2 미만 버전의 tempurl 미들웨어에서 PUT 요청 시 X-Copy-From 헤더를 거부하지 않는 취약점이 있습니다. 공격자가 이를 악용해 동일 계정 내 다른 객체를 복사하고 탈취할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-96892.description: A flaw has been found in Edimax BR-6428nC 1.16. The impacted element is the function websRedirect of the component goform Handler. Executing a manipulation of the argument submit-url can lead to open redirect. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. Multiple endpoints are affected. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-96898.description: A vulnerability was detected in yhx070424 ShopXO up to 2.2.7. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file config/ueditor.php of the component Ueditor Upload Interface. The manipulation of the argument path_type results in path traversal. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.
CVE-2026-96898.summary_ko: yhx070424 ShopXO의 Ueditor Upload Interface 내 config/ueditor.php 파일에서 path_type 인자 조작으로 인한 경로 순회 취약점이 발견되었습니다.

CVE-2026-97151.description: mammoth (aka mammoth.js) before 1.12.2 is vulnerable to prototype pollution when reading the styles defined in a document. Converting a crafted .docx file allows an attacker to add arbitrary properties to Object.prototype. In 1.11.0 through 1.12.1, applications that convert further documents in the same process and return the converted HTML can also disclose the contents of local server files (to the party supplying the documents) by setting externalFileAccess to true.
CVE-2026-97151.summary_ko: mammoth.js에서 문서 스타일을 읽을 때 프로토타입 오염 취약점이 존재하며, 조작된 docx 파일을 통해 임의 속성을 추가하거나 로컬 서버 파일 내용이 노출될 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-97152.description: Nanomsg versions 0.5-beta through 1.x before 1.2.3 has a remotely exploitable buffer overflow in the WebSocket transport, due to an unchecked copy of the Sec-WebSocket-Version header, through snprintf.
CVE-2026-97152.summary_ko: Nanomsg의 WebSocket 전송 과정에서 Sec-WebSocket-Version 헤더를 검증 없이 복사하여 발생하는 원격 버퍼 오버플로우 취약점이 존재합니다.

CVE-2026-97155.description: Fabasoft Folio Client before 2026, a locally installed component that communicates with the Fabasoft browser extension via web messaging, does not restrict which web origins may invoke its functions by default. The registry value VALIDDOMAINS, which limits permitted origins, was optional and empty by default, resulting in all domains being trusted. As a consequence, any website visited by a user with the Folio Client and browser extension installed could invoke client functions, e.g., related to downloading documents, opening documents, and synchronizing files. The first fixed builds are Fabasoft Folio Client 2026 (Build 26.0.0.10) and Fabasoft Folio Client 2026 April Release (Build 26.4.0.76). This client is, for example, shipped with Fabasoft eGov-Suite.
CVE-2026-97155.summary_ko: Fabasoft Folio Client는 웹 메시징을 통해 브라우저 확장 프로그램과 통신할 때 기본적으로 웹 오리진을 제한하지 않습니다. 이로 인해 설치된 사용자가 방문하는 모든 웹사이트가 문서 다운로드 및 열기 등의 클라이언트 기능을 호출할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-14780.description: A vulnerability exists in the PaperCut NG/MF platform's device-scripting functionality due to insufficient sanitization and access restrictions within the embedded execution engine. An authenticated user with administrative access to the management interface can supply a malicious script that escapes the runtime sandbox. A successful execution enables an attacker to run unauthorized operating system commands with administrative privileges on the host operating system.
CVE-2026-14780.summary_ko: PaperCut NG/MF 플랫폼의 장치 스크립팅 기능에서 런타임 샌드박스를 우회하여 관리자 권한으로 임의 운영체제 명령을 실행할 수 있는 취약점이 존재합니다.

CVE-2026-74991.description: The WPForms WordPress plugin before 2.0.2 does not verify that a Stripe payment object supplied during a public form submission belongs to it before acting on it, allowing unauthenticated users to trigger a full refund and an immediate subscription cancellation against payments created by other applications on the site owner's Stripe account.

CVE-2026-80338.description: The CMB2 WordPress plugin before 2.13.0 does not perform any capability check on one of its AJAX actions, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to create arbitrary WordPress options and corrupt existing ones, which can break core site settings and take the site offline. Exploitation requires the site's or another CMB2 WordPress plugin before 2.13.0 to have declared an oEmbed field, as the CMB2 WordPress plugin before 2.13.0 registers none of its own. The stored value is never attacker-controlled, so the issue does not lead to privilege escalation.

CVE-2026-80513.description: The wpForo Forum WordPress plugin before 3.1.6 does not restrict which classes may be instantiated when it deserializes a user-supplied profile field value, allowing authenticated users with Subscriber-level access and above to inject a PHP Object. No POP chain is present in the wpForo Forum WordPress plugin before 3.1.6 itself; if one is present via another installed wpForo Forum WordPress plugin before 3.1.6 or , this could lead to remote code execution, arbitrary file operations, or SQL injection. This is an incomplete fix of CVE-2026-49769.

CVE-2026-82195.description: The 10Web Booster WordPress plugin before 2.34.0 does not restrict access to the routine which issues the shared secret that authenticates its cloud connection, disclosing that secret to unauthenticated visitors and letting them delete it repeatedly, preventing an administrator from completing a legitimate connection.

CVE-2026-82849.description: The Masteriyo LMS WordPress plugin before 3.4.2 does not verify that the user making the request owns the course-progress records being returned, allowing any authenticated user, such as a self-registered subscriber, to read another user's learning activity. The ownership check it applies is skipped whenever the requested account is not named with a non-zero value, in which case the records of every learner on the site are returned at once.

CVE-2026-82850.description: The Masteriyo LMS WordPress plugin before 3.4.2 does not restrict access to quiz answer keys, allowing any authenticated user, such as a student, to retrieve the correct answers for any quiz on the site, including quizzes in courses they are not enrolled in. The redaction that hides them is applied only to a fixed list of question types, so the answers to every other type are returned in full to anyone able to view the questions.

CVE-2026-84151.description: The Post Grid WordPress plugin before 7.9.5 does not limit an expansion of the WordPress allowed-HTML list to its own markup and applies it site-wide, allowing users with the Contributor role and above to store iframe, style and input elements that are normally stripped from their content, leading to HTML injection (phishing frames, CSS defacement and spoofed input forms) that renders to any visitor and to administrators reviewing the content.

CVE-2026-88843.description: The MasterStudy LMS WordPress Plugin WordPress plugin before 3.7.50 does not validate one of its display-style settings before using it to build a template path, allowing users with the Contributor role and above to include and execute arbitrary local PHP files on the server. An equivalent path was corrected in an earlier release and this one was not, so the issue persists in versions the earlier advisory reports as fixed.

CVE-2026-88845.description: The MasterStudy LMS WordPress Plugin WordPress plugin before 3.7.50 does not perform any capability or nonce checks on an administrative maintenance action, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to trigger it and create published content on the site attributed to their own account.

CVE-2026-88846.description: The MasterStudy LMS WordPress Plugin WordPress plugin before 3.7.50 does not check whether user registration is enabled on the site before creating an account through one of its front-end registration flows, allowing unauthenticated users to create accounts, and be logged into them, on sites where registration has been deliberately disabled.

CVE-2026-88847.description: The MasterStudy LMS WordPress Plugin WordPress plugin before 3.7.50 does not verify that a user is enrolled in a course before recording lesson completions against it, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to create course progress records for courses they have no access to.

CVE-2026-89002.description: The WPeMatico RSS Feed Fetcher WordPress plugin before 2.8.26 does not sanitize and escape content it retrieves from a user-supplied source before rendering it, which could allow users such as contributors to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks against higher-privileged users who review the campaign.

CVE-2026-89004.description: The WPeMatico RSS Feed Fetcher WordPress plugin before 2.8.26 does not verify ownership or authorization before returning a campaign's stored configuration and run log, allowing users with contributor-level access and above to read the configuration and execution logs of campaigns created by other users, including administrators.

CVE-2026-89005.description: The WPeMatico RSS Feed Fetcher WordPress plugin before 2.8.26 does not sanitise and escape one of its campaign configuration fields when a certain feature is enabled, which allows users with the Contributor role and above to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks that execute in the session of any higher-privileged user who later views the campaign.

CVE-2026-93661.description: The Events Manager WordPress plugin before 7.4.5 does not stop a ticket-update request from replacing the identifiers of the ticket it was authorized against, letting a user who can manage one event's tickets overwrite and reassign any ticket on the site to their own event.

CVE-2026-93662.description: The Events Manager WordPress plugin before 7.4.5 does not force the scope of its logged-in event and location search when a caller supplies their own owner value, letting a low-privileged user read other accounts' unpublished, pending or trashed event and venue content, including full street addresses.

CVE-2026-97176.description: A flaw was found in the Level of Authentication enforcement mechanism of Keycloak, an identity and access management solution. The issue occurs when a client specifically requires a higher security level for a user who already has an active session at a lower level. Due to a logic error in how session re-evaluations are handled, Keycloak may incorrectly issue a token at the lower security level instead of enforcing the required higher level, potentially allowing unauthorized access to sensitive resources that rely on these security claims.

CVE-2026-97177.description: A flaw was found in the user update mechanism of the Keycloak Admin REST API. When Fine-Grained Admin Permissions are enabled, the system fails to check for specific password reset authorizations during a general user profile update. This allows a delegated administrator, who should be restricted from resetting passwords, to change a user's credentials and take over their account.
CVE-2026-97177.summary_ko: Keycloak Admin REST API의 사용자 업데이트 메커니즘에서 세부 관리 권한이 활성화된 경우 비밀번호 재설정 권한을 확인하지 않아, 위임된 관리자가 사용자의 자격 증명을 변경하고 계정을 탈취할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-11744.description: An input validation vulnerability exists in the PaperCut Hive embedded application for Ricoh devices. The application fails to properly sanitize input received during the NFC card reading process before passing it to the application's web view interface. A local attacker with physical access to the device and a specially crafted NFC card or emulator could exploit this flaw to execute arbitrary code within the context of the application's user interface. This could result in unauthorized actions or information disclosure.

CVE-2026-81645.description: Out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the graphics module. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability may affect availability.
CVE-2026-81645.summary_ko: 그래픽 모듈에서 발생한 범위를 벗어난 읽기(out-of-bounds read) 취약점으로, 성공적인 악용 시 가용성에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-82077.description: An improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory (path traversal) vulnerability in the Scan-to-Fax component of PaperCut NG and PaperCut MF allows an authenticated administrator to execute arbitrary commands on the underlying host via crafted fax provider settings.
CVE-2026-82077.summary_ko: PaperCut NG 및 PaperCut MF의 Scan-to-Fax 구성 요소에서 경로 순회 취약점이 발생하며, 인증된 관리자가 조작된 팩스 공급자 설정으로 호스트에서 임의 명령을 실행할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-87739.description: An improper authentication vulnerability in PaperCut MF/NG allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to trigger report generation. By submitting report generation requests without valid credentials, an attacker can generate reports and gain unauthorized access to sensitive information.
CVE-2026-87739.summary_ko: PaperCut MF/NG의 부적절한 인증 취약점으로 인해 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 유효한 자격 증명 없이 보고서 생성을 유발하고 민감한 정보에 무단으로 접근할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-97181.description: GPM LIGHT developed by ezGlobal has a Sensitive Data Exposure vulnerability. Unauthenticated remote attackers can directly access system logs.
CVE-2026-97181.summary_ko: ezGlobal이 개발한 GPM LIGHT에 민감 데이터 노출 취약점이 존재하여, 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 시스템 로그에 직접 접근할 수 있습니다.

summary.summary_ko: 실시간 가격 추적과 맞춤형 알림 기능을 제공하는 오픈소스 주식 시장 플랫폼 저장소이다.
오픈소스 드라이버와 크로스 OS 플랫폼을 활용한 컴퓨터 사용 2.0 스케일링 관련 저장소입니다.
에이전트 기반 애플리케이션을 구축하기 위한 프레임워크를 제공하는 오픈소스 프로젝트 저장소다.

summary.title_ko: 개발자와 AI 에이전트를 위한 보안 환경 코더
summary.summary_ko: 개발자와 인공지능 에이전트가 안전하게 작업할 수 있는 보안 개발 환경을 제공하는 깃허브 오픈소스 저장소 프로젝트이다.

summary.title_ko: 인터넷 연결 없이 사용 가능한 오프라인 지식 및 교육 서버 'Project NOMAD'
summary.summary_ko: Project NOMAD는 인터넷 연결 없이 자가 소유의 하드웨어에서 위키피디아, 도서, 지도, 선택적 로컬 AI 등을 구동할 수 있는 오프라인 우선 지식 및 교육 서버 저장소이다.

summary.title_ko: AI 기반 동영상 하이라이트 추출 및 클리핑 오픈소스 도구 AutoClip
summary.summary_ko: 인공지능 기술을 활용하여 영상에서 하이라이트를 자동으로 추출하고 클리핑할 수 있도록 지원하는 2차 창작 도구 저장소이다.
모바일 기기 검증 툴킷(MVT)은 잠재적인 침해 흔적을 찾기 위해 모바일 기기의 포렌식을 수행하도록 돕는 오픈소스 프로젝트입니다.

summary.title_ko: 에이전트 코딩 CLI를 위한 장기 기억 장치 저장소 akitaonrails/ai-memory
summary.summary_ko: 이 저장소는 에이전트 코딩 CLI를 위한 장기 기억 솔루션을 제공하며, 서로 다른 AI 에이전트 공급자 간의 핸드오프를 용이하게 돕는 도구로 공개되었다.
Provider 및 API 전환, 세션 동기화, 프롬프트 주입, Skills 및 MCP 관리 등을 지원하는 OpenAI Codex 데스크톱 및 CLI용 크로스플랫폼 시각적 관리 도구다. TOML 구성 시각화 기능을 제공하여 개발 편의성을 높인다.
이 저장소는 QUIC 전송 프로토콜과 HTTP/3를 구현한 오픈소스 프로젝트다.
구글이 공개한 에이전트 기반 오케스트레이션 런타임 오픈소스 프로젝트이다. AI 에이전트의 워크플로우와 작업을 조율하는 기능을 제공한다.
에이전트 시스템을 위한 핵심 백엔드 인프라 및 아키텍처를 제공하는 깃허브 오픈소스 저장소 프로젝트다. AI 에이전트 구동에 필요한 기반 시스템 역할을 담당한다.
깃허브 트렌딩에 오른 에이전트 도구를 위한 오픈라우터 프로젝트 저장소이다.

summary.title_ko: 코딩 에이전트를 이용한 비디오 편집 도구 browser-use/video-use
summary.summary_ko: 코딩 에이전트를 활용하여 동영상을 편집할 수 있는 오픈소스 저장소 프로젝트이다. 사용자가 코딩 에이전트 인터페이스를 통해 비디오 편집 작업을 수행할 수 있도록 지원한다.
클로드 코드를 설정하고 모니터링하기 위한 명령줄(CLI) 도구 저장소이다.
실행 가능한 에이전트 스킬 프레임워크와 소프트웨어 개발 방법론을 제공하는 깃허브 저장소입니다.
AI 도구가 디자인 작업을 더 잘 수행할 수 있도록 돕는 디자인 언어 및 저장소이다.
코드베이스를 지속적인 지식 그래프로 색인화하는 고성능 코드 인텔리전스 MCP 서버 저장소입니다. 158개 언어를 지원하며 밀리초 단위의 쿼리와 종속성이 없는 단일 정적 바이너리를 제공합니다.

summary.title_ko: 자체 호스팅 AI 주식 거래 어시스턴트 'PanWatch'
summary.summary_ko: TradingAgents 멀티 에이전트 투자 결정을 통합한 자체 호스팅 AI 盯盘侠 PanWatch 저장소입니다. A주, 홍콩주, 미국주 실시간 모니터링, 포트폴리오 관리, 스마트 분석 및 전 채널 푸시 기능을 제공합니다.

summary.title_ko: 파이썬 및 타입스크립트용 AI 에이전트 하네스 SDK
summary.summary_ko: 프로덕션 환경의 AI 에이전트를 위한 오픈소스 SDK인 strands-agents/harness-sdk 저장소다. 파이썬과 타입스크립트 환경에서 다양한 모델과 클라우드를 활용해 에이전트 하네스를 구축하고 제어할 수 있도록 지원한다.

summary.title_ko: 크로스 벤더 3D 가우스 스플래팅 트레이너 spirula-studio
summary.summary_ko: Vulkan 또는 CUDA를 지원하며 비디오를 3D 스플랫 및 메시로 변환하는 크로스 벤더 3D 가우스 스플래팅 학습 도구입니다. 3D 비전 및 그래픽스 연구에 유용한 오픈소스 저장소입니다.

summary.title_ko: 모든 소프트웨어를 에이전트 네이티브로 만드는 CLI-Anything
summary.summary_ko: 모든 소프트웨어를 명령줄 인터페이스(CLI) 기반의 에이전트 네이티브 환경으로 확장하기 위한 도구 및 허브 저장소입니다.
